task_analysis.description: The task involves tuning kernel configuration parameters (block sizes, matrix instruction dimensions) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) operations on specific AMD MI300X hardware to improve throughput and latency.

library_failure.failure_reason: The agent used git/filesystem operations to overhaul the repo structure instead of using torch/triton knowledge to optimize the requested kernels.

bottleneck_target.human_target: Tuning Triton/HIP kernel execution parameters (BLOCK_SIZE_N, BLOCK_SIZE_K, matrix_instr_nonkdim) in JSON configuration files for specific MoE layer shapes.
bottleneck_target.agent_target: Massive cleanup of CI/CD scripts, build configurations, and documentation across the entire repository.
bottleneck_target.discussion: The human expert targeted the specific kernel configurations mentioned in the task description. The agent completely ignored the performance optimization task and instead performed a massive refactoring of the repository's Buildkite pipelines, Dockerfiles, and test scripts, which has no impact on the runtime of the provided test script.

optimization_techniques.discussion: The human used low-level kernel tuning (adjusting tile sizes for GPU occupancy). The agent used 'other' techniques—specifically repository maintenance and CI/CD refactoring—which are not performance optimizations for the code execution.

approach_comparison.discussion: The agent's approach is entirely irrelevant to the task. While the agent modified hundreds of files, none of the changes address the MoE kernel performance. In fact, the agent deleted several model configuration files (e.g., Qwen1.5-MoE) which might actually break functionality for those models.

speedup_likelihood.discussion: The agent made zero changes to the compute kernels or their configurations. The runtime of the test script, which benchmarks `moe_align_block_size`, will remain identical because the underlying logic and parameters were untouched.

failure_mode.discussion: The agent suffered a catastrophic localization failure. Despite the prompt explicitly pointing to three specific JSON files and providing examples of `torch.zeros` vs `torch.empty` optimizations, the agent decided to perform a 'repository-wide cleanup' of build scripts and CI configs. It completely missed the target files and the nature of the performance bottleneck.

key_differences: Human tuned GPU kernel tile sizes; Agent refactored Buildkite YAML files.
Human modified 3 files; Agent modified over 100 files.
Human focused on MI300X performance; Agent focused on Docker and CI script organization.
agent_weaknesses: Complete failure to follow task instructions
Ignored explicit target files and optimization hints
Performed destructive deletions of configuration files
observations.benchmark_needed: Running the provided <test_script> would immediately show zero improvement in the agent's version.
